scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/payroll-portal build && powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue artifacts/payroll-portal/dist/_redirects" && npx wrangler deploy
